  |> yield(name: "last")

spec.title: Daily PnL by Mimid Account Level ${level}

spec.query: SELECT last("pnl") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_daily_pnl" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ AND "level" =~ /^$level$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)

SELECT sum("pnl") FROM (
  SELECT last("pnl") as "pnl" FROM "acct_lvl_daily_pnl"
  WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ AND "level" =~ /^$level$/) AND $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)
) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("grp_risk") FROM "default"."acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ AND "level" =~ /^$level$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none)

SELECT sum("last_grp_risk") AS sum_acct_lvl_grp_risk
FROM ( SELECT abs(last("grp_risk")) as last_grp_risk FROM "default"."acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ AND "level" =~ /^$level$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none) )
GROUP BY time($__interval)

SELECT sum("last_grp_risk") AS sum_acct_lvl_grp_risk
FROM ( SELECT last("grp_risk") as last_grp_risk FROM "default"."acct_lvl_grp_risk" WHERE ("label" =~ /^$label$/ AND "level" =~ /^$level$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "label", "level" fill(none) )
GROUP BY time($__interval)
